fusions.name: Carve for the Table
fusions.desc: Carves around you with a two-tined fork. The cut deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and restores 8 health to you. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Last Morsel
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A thrown skewer deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets within 5 tiles, and you heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Turning Spit
fusions.desc: Plants a spit of roasting meat where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Loaded Skewer
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you eat what is on the skewer and are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
